objective: A run with nothing to compare against says so rather than reporting zeros
preconditions: a project whose first run has just finished
input: A comparison of the first run in a fresh project
expected: Refused with an explanation. Zeros would read as "nothing changed", which is a claim, and "there is nothing to compare with" is the truth
detail: 400: There is no earlier finished run in this project to compare against. A first run has nothing to have changed from.
